title: Bob Martin   SOLID Principles of Object Oriented and Agile Design
summary: Robert C. Martin (Uncle Bob) gives a talk on the SOLID principles of object-oriented and agile design, in the context of encapsulation and clean code.
why: Cited in discussions of OO design, access modifiers and private fields, and why writing messy code slows you down.

quote.text: there's an interesting talk from Uncle Bob saying exactly that
